candidate.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, beating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan
candidate.excerpt: The Alaska race was the last U.S. Senate contest to be resolved in this year's midterm elections and gave Democrats a 56-44 majority after they flipped nine GOP-held seats to retake the chamber.

publishedSummary: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate race, according to Al Jazeera, BBC World and NPR Politics. The excerpt says it was the last U.S. Senate contest resolved in this year's midterm elections and that Democrats flipped nine GOP-held seats to retake the chamber.
